statement: The visible product brand is DocForge and the workbench is described as a general Markdown to Word document workshop.
Open, save, validate, template selection, DOCX build, preview mode, Office PDF selection and cancellation retain their current transport behavior.
At 1440x1024 the document outline, Markdown editor, Microsoft Word preview and contextual diagnostics match the selected reference hierarchy.
The mobile breakpoint exposes outline, editor, preview and diagnostics without horizontal overflow.
No frontend UI change introduces a dependency into the parser, domain, compiler, RenderPlan or DOCX renderer.
